channel.title: Power Back Weekly
channel.description: The record, read out loud. Every Sunday, Power Back Weekly walks through what your lawmakers actually did that week: the votes, the bills that moved, and whose record changed, straight from the public record and in plain English. Every Thursday, founder maveriQ B Jackson, in his own voice, on what it means and what you can do about it. Special Session episodes drop when something big moves, and On the Record brings lawmakers and Coloradans on the show. From The Q Collective, a nonpartisan, citizen-powered accountability project. Sunday episodes open with Mav and are read by an AI voice from our published data; every fact links back to the record at theqcollective.org.
